pip-compile.description: requirements.txt and dev-requirements.txt are pip-compile lockfiles; Renovate reads the command and Python version from their headers.

pip_requirements.description: pip-compile already handles the .in files; this manager would also edit the lockfiles directly.

docker-compose.description: docker-compose.yaml only references the locally built telegram_bot image.

packageRules.description: Give new PyPI releases a week before proposing them.
Stay on the Python 3.13 line; moving minor version also means regenerating the lockfiles and updating CI, so do it by hand.
One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps.
